purpose: Joint retained-node/edge and persuasion-slot integer optimization as a structural candidate generator
cohort: previously consumed P8 six legacy families, repetition 501, standard response
model: binary alive nodes, retained edges, monotone communication slots and edge-slot products; fixed shield counts 1,3,5,8,12,15; two fractional-objective updates per count
limits: 0.5 seconds per MILP, at most six distinct proposals; one worker; solver time limits may produce machine-dependent incumbents, which must be reported without optimality claims
rescoring: exact component settlement after all shields, with mean-response communication allocation; best plan selected on five paired scenarios and checked on eight unused paired scenarios
strict: positive mean and nonnegative minimum in both selection and audit
mean_audited: positive mean in both selection and audit; report negative individual scenarios and realized losses
execution: search once after full scan, execute only the accepted complete shield prefix, then resume the current bounded P9 policy
decision: complete six cases in both arms; only a positive mean over P9 with zero failed actions can proceed to wider development; no qualification from this cohort
